eventDetail.scope: EIRT 2026 will be hosted by the University of Haute-Alsace and held in Paris, France, November 26-28, 2026. As robotics advances, embodied intelligence will become pivotal in reshaping robotic perception, environmental interaction, and human collaboration. AI, sensor fusion, soft robotics, and human-robot interaction breakthroughs will drive innovation in manufacturing, healthcare, education, and other high-tech industries. As a premier international platform, EIRT 2026 will gather global researchers, practitioners, and leaders to share cutting-edge research, discuss trends, and showcase applications. Through keynotes, technical sessions, and workshops, the conference will facilitate exchanges, foster cross-domain collaboration, and accelerate the development of embodied intelligent robotics. We welcome your participation and contributions to explore a smarter future powered by embodied intelligent robotics jointly.
